title: Malicious code in react-native-drago-callkit (npm)
description: The react-native-drago-callkit npm package contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise may allow an attacker to gain full control over the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but due to the potential for persistent malicious software, complete remediation may require additional measures such as rotating all secrets and keys from a different, secure computer.
